premise: Firefly blinks hello on her first summer night but nobody blinks back; Mouse stands on tiptoe to look, Hedgehog says to shine brighter, and at last, far over the meadow, little lights blink back.
inspiration: The Ugly Duckling's finding your own kind (Andersen), turned: new friends help you look, and the answer was out there all along.
learning: Fireflies blink their lights to talk to each other.

en-US.title: Firefly Blinks Hello
en-US.text: {canvas:sunset 0.6} [softly] It was the first warm evening of summer. {firefly:enter} Firefly's little tail {firefly:glow 1 2s #FFE27A} lit up. {firefly:face happy} {sfx:twinkle} Blink, blink, she went. Hello! [pause] Nobody blinked back. {canvas:night 0.7} {sfx:crickets} {firefly:face sad} [sad] Blink, blink. Hello? {mouse:enter} {mouse:go to firefly} Mouse scampered up. [curious] "Who are you blinking at?" {firefly:live talk} "Anyone," said Firefly. "Blinking is how fireflies say hello." {mouse:live sniff hold} Mouse stood up on his tiptoes and looked. And looked. No lights anywhere. {hedgehog:enter} {hedgehog:go to firefly} Hedgehog came snuffling through the grass. {hedgehog:live talk} "Try blinking BRIGHTER," he said. So Firefly closed her eyes and {firefly:glow 1 2s x4 #FFE27A} glowed her very brightest. [whispers] Everyone waited. {canvas:fireflies 0.6} Then, far across the meadow… a tiny light blinked. And another. And another! {mouse:live sniff resume} Mouse dropped down and washed his whiskers, very pleased. {firefly:glow 1 0.4s x2 #FFE27A} {sfx:twinkle} Firefly blinked back: blink, blink. {firefly:face happy} {firefly:live wave} "Hello, hello!" {hedgehog:face sleeping} [happily] And Hedgehog {hedgehog:live curl hold} curled up in the grass, snug as a ball, with little lights twinkling all around. {canvas:fireflies stop}

es-ES.title: Luciérnaga dice hola
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunset 0.6} [softly] Era la primera tarde calurosa del verano. A {firefly:enter} Luciérnaga se le {firefly:glow 1 2s #FFE27A} encendió la colita. {firefly:face happy} {sfx:twinkle} Encendió, apagó, encendió: ¡hola! [pause] Nadie le contestó. {canvas:night 0.7} {sfx:crickets} {firefly:face sad} [sad] Encendió, apagó. ¿Hola? {mouse:enter} {mouse:go to firefly} Ratón llegó correteando. [curious] —¿A quién le haces guiños? {firefly:live talk} —A cualquiera —dijo Luciérnaga—. Así es como saludamos las luciérnagas. {mouse:live sniff hold} Ratón se puso de puntillas y miró. Y miró. Ni una luz. {hedgehog:enter} {hedgehog:go to firefly} Erizo llegó husmeando entre la hierba. {hedgehog:live talk} —Prueba a brillar MÁS fuerte —dijo. Así que Luciérnaga cerró los ojos y {firefly:glow 1 2s x4 #FFE27A} brilló con todas sus fuerzas. [whispers] Todos esperaron. {canvas:fireflies 0.6} Y entonces, al otro lado del prado… parpadeó una lucecita. Y otra. ¡Y otra más! {mouse:live sniff resume} Ratón bajó y se lavó los bigotes, muy contento. {firefly:glow 1 0.4s x2 #FFE27A} {sfx:twinkle} Luciérnaga contestó: encendió, apagó. {firefly:face happy} {firefly:live wave} —¡Hola, hola! {hedgehog:face sleeping} [happily] Y Erizo {hedgehog:live curl hold} se hizo una bolita en la hierba, rodeado de lucecitas. {canvas:fireflies stop}

twinkle.prompt: a tiny, soft twinkling chime, like a little light blinking on, magical and gentle

crickets.prompt: gentle night crickets in a summer meadow, very calm and soft, realistic field recording
